ValidationRule.description: It doesn't allow user without NSP Service Stakeholder check to change the project template
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.ProjectValidations__c ) , NOT( $User.NSP_Service_Stakeholder__c ) , NOT( $Permission.Service_Stakeholder ) , OR( pse__Is_Template__c , Is_Opportunity_Template__c ) )
